verses.text: <pb/>Ubangiji ya ba Musa da Haruna waɗannan umarnai.
Duk sa'ad da Isra'ilawa suka yi zango, kowane mutum zai sauka a inda tutar ƙungiyar kabilarsa take. Zangon zai kasance a kewaye da alfarwa ta sujada.

Ƙungiyoyin kabilar Yahuza za su sauka su kafa tutarsu a sashin gabas a ƙarƙashin jagorancin shugabanninsu, kamar haka, <pb/><t><n>[Kabila]</n> — <n>[Shugaba]</n> — <n>[Jimilla]</n> <pb/>Yahuza — Nashon ɗan Amminadab — 74,600 <pb/>Issaka — Netanel ɗan Zuwar — 54,400 <pb/>Zabaluna — Eliyab ɗan Helon — 57,400</t> <pb/>Jimilla duka,(186,400) dubu ɗari da tamanin da shida da ɗari huɗu. <pb/>Ƙungiyoyin kabilar Yahuza su ne za su fara tafiya.

<pb/>Ƙungiyoyin kabilar Ra'ubainu za su sauka su kafa tutarsu a sashin kudu a ƙarƙashin jagorancin shugabanninsu, kamar haka, <pb/><t><n>[Kabila]</n> — <n>[Shugaba]</n> — <n>[Jimilla]</n> <pb/>Ra'ubainu — Elizur ɗan Shedeyur — 46,500 <pb/>Saminu — Shelumiyel ɗan Zurishaddai — 59,300 <pb/>Gad — Eliyasaf ɗan Deyuwel — 45,650</t> <pb/>Jimilla duka, 151,450) duba ɗari da hamsin da ɗaya, da ɗari huɗu da hamsin. <pb/>Ƙungiyoyin kabilar Ra'ubainu za su bi bayan na Yahuza.

<pb/>Sa'an nan Lawiyawa ɗauke da alfarwa ta sujada za su kasance a tsakanin ƙungiyoyi biyu na farko da biyun da suke daga ƙarshe. Kowace ƙungiya za ta yi tafiya kamar yadda aka dokace ta ta zauna a zango, wato kowacce ta yi tafiya a ƙarƙashin tutarta a matsayinta.

Ƙungiyoyin kabilar Ifraimu za su sauka su kafa tutarsu a sashin yamma a ƙarƙashin jagorancin shugabanninsu, kamar haka, <pb/><t><n>[Kabilar]</n> — <n>[Shugaba]</n> — <n>[Jimilla]</n> <pb/>Ifraimu — Elishama ɗan Ammihud — 40,500 <pb/>Manassa — Gamaliyel ɗan Fedazur — 32,200 <pb/>Biliyaminu — Abidan ɗan Gideyoni — 35,400</t> <pb/>Jimilla duka, (108,100) dubu ɗari da takwas, da ɗari ɗaya daidai. <pb/>Ƙungiyoyin Ifraimu za su zama na uku a jerin.

<pb/>Ƙungiyoyin kabilar Dan za su sauka su kafa tutarsu a sashin arewa a ƙarƙashin jagorancin shugabanninsu, kamar haka, <pb/><t><n>[Kabila]</n> — <n>[Shugaba]</n> — <n>[Jimilla]</n> <pb/>Dan — Ahiyezer ɗan Ammishaddai — 62,700 <pb/>Ashiru — Fagiyel ɗan Okran — 41,500 <pb/>Naftali — Ahira ɗan Enan — 53,400</t> <pb/>Jimilla duka, (157,600) duba ɗari da hamsin da bakwai, da ɗari shida. <pb/>Ƙungiyoyin Dan za su bi daga bayan duka.
<pb/>Jimillar yawan Isra'ilawa da aka rubuta su a yadda suke ƙungiya ƙungiya, su dubu ɗari shida da uku da ɗari biyar da hamsin ne (603,550).
Amma kamar yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa, ba a rubuta Lawiyawa haɗe da sauran Isra'ilawa ba.
<pb/>Saboda haka Isra'ilawa suka yi dukan abin da Ubangiji ya umarci Musa. Kowa ya yi zango a ƙarƙashin tutarsa, kowa kuma ya yi tafiya cikin jerin kabilarsa.
